# Verbose logging

The commands `mt help` lists under Verbose logging.

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`verbose-get`](#verbose-get) | Show whether verbose logging (mt's own debug logs) is on |
| [`verbose-set`](#verbose-set) | Turn verbose logging on or off: mt writes its own debug logs to the console, from the next time it starts |

## verbose-get

Show whether verbose logging (mt's own debug logs) is on.

```text
mt verbose-get
```

Doesn't need you to sign in.

## verbose-set

Turn verbose logging on or off: mt writes its own debug logs to the console, from the next time it starts.

```text
mt verbose-set <enabled>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<enabled>` | text | yes |  | true to turn verbose logging on, false to turn it off |

Doesn't need you to sign in.
